name: singlet_markers_de_cell_level_two_group_de
title: Cell-level two-group differential expression
description: Tests each gene for a difference between two groups of cells, treating every cell as an independent observation. Writes per-gene statistics, p-values, FDR-adjusted values, log fold changes and ranks. The default is a tie-corrected Wilcoxon test. Use it only when cells are the true unit, such as cell-line mixtures or simulations; for donor or sample designs use replicate-aware condition DE instead.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

seed.description: Permutation seed for inference.null_calibration; the test itself is deterministic.

method.description: Two-group test: wilcoxon (rank, default), t-test (Welch), mast (hurdle) or desingle (ZINB likelihood ratio).

contrast.description: Group contrast: the two-level column in key, with group tested against reference.

key.description: obs column holding the two-level group label.

group.description: Level of the contrast column to test.

reference.description: Comparison level, or rest for all other cells.

layer.description: Expression layer; auto uses layers/log1p_norm for wilcoxon, t-test and mast, and layers/counts for desingle.

covariates.description: obs columns added to the mast design, for example a detection-rate column; ignored by other methods.

min_cells_per_group.description: Genes with fewer cells than this in either group are not tested.

min_detect_frac.description: Minimum fraction of cells expressing the gene in at least one group.

fdr_threshold.description: Adjusted p-value threshold for calling a gene DE.

null_calibration.description: Empirical null for calibrated FDR; donor_permutation needs donor_key.

donor_key.description: obs column with donor or sample identifiers; required for donor_permutation.

options.description: Method-specific options; each block applies only to the method it names.

tie_correct.description: Use the tie-corrected rank variance; recommended for zero-inflated data.

ebayes.description: Empirical-Bayes variance shrinkage in the MAST fit, as in its default.

type_threshold.description: Threshold for classifying DEs, DEa and DEg genes; must be in (0, 0.1].

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written: uns/de_cell_level and uns/de_cell_level_diagnostics. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: n_tested, n_called, top_genes (gene, logfc, padj), calibration (called fraction under the null, or null) and confounding (flags, or null).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
